cases.note: The real engine's std and os, as qjs runs them on WASI: its globals, signals, strerror, the environment, writeFile and loadFile, fdopen, FILE calls, evalScript and loadScript, os.sleep, and its timers.

files.p.js:
const r = []
const P = (k, f) => {
  try {
    const v = f()
    r.push(k + ' = ' + JSON.stringify(v, (_, x) => (typeof x === 'bigint' ? 'big:' + x : x)))
  } catch (e) {
    r.push(k + ' ! ' + (e && e.name) + ': ' + (e && e.message))
  }
}
// bjson, the engine's binary JSON, is the real engine's alone.
P('globals', () => Object.getOwnPropertyNames(globalThis).filter((n) => !/^[A-Z]/.test(n) && n !== 'bjson').sort().join(' '))
P('SIG', () => [os.SIGINT, os.SIGABRT, os.SIGFPE, os.SIGILL, os.SIGSEGV, os.SIGTERM])
P('exePath', () => os.exePath())
P('now', () => typeof os.now())
P('strerror', () => [std.strerror(2), std.strerror(44), std.strerror(0), std.strerror(9999)])
P('getenviron', () => typeof std.getenviron())
P('setenv', () => { std.setenv('ZZ', 'v'); return [std.getenv('ZZ'), std.getenviron().ZZ] })
P('unsetenv', () => { std.unsetenv('ZZ'); return [std.getenv('ZZ'), 'ZZ' in std.getenviron()] })
P('writeFile str', () => std.writeFile('/data/w1', 'hello'))
P('loadFile w1', () => std.loadFile('/data/w1'))

P('fdopen', () => { const fd = os.open('/data/w1', os.O_RDONLY); const f = std.fdopen(fd, 'r'); const s = f.readAsString(); const n = f.fileno(); f.close(); return [fd, n, s] })
P('fdopen bad', () => { const e = {}; const f = std.fdopen(99, 'r', e); return [f, e.errno] })

P('fileno', () => { const f = std.open('/data/w1', 'r'); const n = f.fileno(); f.close(); return n })
P('std fileno', () => [std.in.fileno(), std.out.fileno(), std.err.fileno()])
P('tello', () => { const f = std.open('/data/w1', 'r'); f.seek(2, std.SEEK_SET); const t = f.tello(); f.close(); return [typeof t, String(t)] })

P('puts', () => std.puts('P\n'))
P('evalScript', () => std.evalScript('1+2'))
P('evalScript global', () => { std.evalScript('var gq = 5'); return globalThis.gq })
P('loadScript', () => { std.writeFile('/data/s.js', 'globalThis.ls = 9; 3*3'); return [std.loadScript('/data/s.js'), globalThis.ls] })

cases.note: std.in, std.out and std.err and descriptors 0 to 2 as qjs on WASI has them: a pipe with no position, stdio's buffer between FILE and os.read, EINVAL writing input and EBADF reading output; the wasi-libc strerror table and std.Error.

cases.note: Once the script ends, the loop calls a read handler while its descriptor reads and a timer once it is due, until none is left; a callback that throws ends the run with 1. The real engine's message adds a stack.

files.p.js:
const t = os.setTimeout(() => {}, 1)
print('setTimeout returns', typeof t, JSON.stringify(t))
os.clearTimeout(12345)
print('clear unknown ok')
print('stdin seek', std.in.seek(0, std.SEEK_SET), 'tell', std.in.tell())
try { std.writeFile('/data/w8', undefined) } catch (e) { print('w8', e.message) }
print('w8 exists', os.stat('/data/w8')[1], JSON.stringify(std.loadFile('/data/w8')))
let n = 0
os.setReadHandler(0, () => { const l = std.in.getline(); print('rh', JSON.stringify(l)); if (l === null || ++n > 3) os.setReadHandler(0, null) })
const fd = os.open('/data/w1', os.O_RDONLY | os.O_CREAT)
let m = 0
os.setReadHandler(fd, () => { m++; if (m === 2) { os.setReadHandler(fd, null); print('file rh 2') } })
os.setTimeout(() => { print('before throw'); throw new Error('boom') }, 500)
os.setTimeout(() => print('after throw timer'), 1000)
print('end of script')
